ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering the Minnesota Welfare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the complex network of entities and individuals involved in the $9B+ Minnesota welfare fraud scandal.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to uncover the scope and depth of the scandal.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What is the scope of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and bring accountability to those involved.

ideas.title: The Federal Reserve Investigation: A Threat to Central Bank Independence?
ideas.description: Investigate the implications of the Federal Reserve investigation on the central bank's independence and potential misconduct by high-ranking officials.
ideas.angle: Public records and whistleblower accounts could shed light on the probe.
questions: What are the allegations against Jerome Powell?
How does this impact the Federal Reserve's independence?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant misconduct at the highest levels of the Federal Reserve.
